messages:
deploybot: PREDEPLOY CHECK FAILED — env-parity mismatch detected for service=embed-service. prod missing secret key: EMBED_ALIAS. release paused.
sam: taking this. @yuki can you confirm if we rolled alias during the staging patch last night?
yuki: yes, staging uses embed/alias/v3 after the key rotation at 02:12UTC. prod still points at embed/alias/v2. release notes mention v3 in the changelog.
ops: how did staging smoke pass? is the code tolerant of both?
yuki: code expects v3 for new model-variant; fallback to v2 removed in latest build. smoke tests in staging ran against staging secret (v3) so passed. deploybot only checks for secret presence, not value.
sam: quick diff: `kubectl -n inference get secret embed-config -o jsonpath='{.data.alias}' | base64 --decode` -> staging: `embed/alias/v3`, prod: `embed/alias/v2`.
audit-bot: Note: last change to prod secret by user `yuki` at 2026-03-18T23:58Z set alias to v2.
yuki: i scheduled a secret rotation last night but only applied to staging (my mistake).
sam: options list: 1) hotpatch prod secret with v3 alias (fast but needs KMS admin approval), 2) rollback release to image that supports v2, 3) deploy a temporary compatibility shim that checks both aliases (requires code change + quick canary).
release-eng: change window ends in 45m. ops prefers rollback unless we can prove hotpatch in <10m with no privilege escalation.
ops: confirm — prod KMS policy denies direct patch without an admin grant. hotpatch requires a one-time privileged action.
yuki: i can request grant but it will take ~30m to approve.
sam: not safe. i will prepare rollback PR to pin image `registry/redwood/embedder:20260318-legacy` and update release notes. ETA 12m.
release-eng: if rollback, annotate changelog: "rollback: pinned embedder image due to secret alias rotation mismatch between staging/prod; follow-up: secret parity automation."
ops: also add a short-term mitigation: create a read-only daily job that compares secret alias values across envs and alerts on drift.
audit-bot: creating ticket #RL-4021 for secret-parity job and #RL-4022 for deploybot value-check enhancement.
yuki: after rollback, i'll coordinate a manual reconciliation of aliases with ops during next change window.
sam: applying rollback: `kubectl -n inference set image deploy/embedder embedder=registry/redwood/embedder:20260318-legacy`
deploybot: image set detected, running post-deploy health checks.
ops: watching metrics + traces, tailing logs: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=embedder -f --since=2m`
sam: post-deploy smoke looks OK, readiness green.
yuki: filing a blameless postmortem and adding note to runbook: "when rotating KMS aliases, update prod overlays and trigger parity check job."
release-eng: resolution: rollback applied, promotion paused until 09:00UTC tomorrow. raising follow-ups and assigning to ops+sre.
sam: updating release thread & changelog now.
deploybot: thread closed after rollback success check.
